strategic_horizon.medium_term_goal: Prove the first real industry benchmark end-to-end: archived original evidence must support no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a meaningful cycle, and the resulting primitives must be demonstrably reusable rather than industry-specific hacks.
strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Finish evidence-based saturation measurement for the active blind Memory Atlas on the revised 2015-2026 primary horizon: use compact indices and selective batch3 novelty classification to identify the first genuinely sealable high-value shards without fresh-search contamination.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: After the first shard legitimately seals, let the high-capability model perform self-verification/search discovery, compile claim-scoped evidence tasks, archive original sources, and build the first evidence-backed historical replay slice.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Stop or re-rank local work when it no longer materially improves coverage, evidence traceability, point-in-time replay, a main-path blocker, or continuity correctness. Tooling, lead count, schema elegance, lint, handoff polish and Agent orchestration are never self-justifying objectives.
parallel_permanent_tracks: Keep current-source collection source-first/archive-now so today's original material does not become tomorrow's recovery gap.
